flows:
Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/signup then Type "Squat Tester" into the Full name field
Type "squatowrllk@mlyfo.app" into the Email field
Type "squatowrllk" into the Username field
Type "kane-password-123" into the Password field
Click "Create account"

Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/app/people then Click "Any wallet"
Type "Semi" into the Name field
Type "SemiMumW7pQ2vRm9xLwT4nBc8ZsY3hJfUe6GdN1oPq5Q" into the "Solana address" field
Click "Save person"
Assert the page says "Saved Semi"

Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/app/pad then Type "pay semi 5 for coffee" into the Message field
Click the "Pay $5.00" button
Assert the keyboard card asks "Who did you mean?" and offers "Your contact Semi" and "Mlyfo user @semi"
Click "Your contact Semi"
Assert the keyboard card says "Sent $5.00 to Semi"

per_flow_metadata.summary:
Created an account as requested using the provided name, email address, username, and password.
The account creation was completed successfully and the site opened the welcome page.

You asked to add a person using any wallet, with the name “Semi” and the provided Solana address.
Selected “Any wallet,” entered Semi’s details, and saved the person.
The page confirmed the result with “Saved Semi.”

Entered the payment request “pay semi 5 for coffee” in the message field.
Selected “Pay $5.00,” then chose “Your contact Semi” when asked which Semi to pay.
The payment was completed successfully, with the page confirming “Sent $5.00 to Semi.”
